title: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate & Postgraduate Scholarship 2026-27
award_summary: Up to ₹2,00,000 (UG) and ₹6,00,000 (PG) across any degree stream + leadership workshops
summary: Premier private corporate merit-cum-means scholarship supporting 5,000 undergraduate and postgraduate students from ANY stream (BA, B.Com, B.Sc, B.Tech, LLB, MBA) with financial aid and alumni mentorship.

eligibility_criteria.text: Resident citizen of India enrolled full-time in 1st year of any recognized UG or PG degree (Arts, Commerce, Science, Law, Engg).
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: You must be an Indian citizen in your first year of any college degree (BA, B.Com, B.Sc, B.Tech, LLB, etc.).

eligibility_criteria.text: Passed Class 12 or qualifying UG exam with minimum 60% aggregate marks.
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: Your previous qualifying total marks must be 60% or higher.

eligibility_criteria.text: Annual household income up to ₹15 Lakhs (preference given to < ₹2.5 Lakhs).
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: Your total family income from all sources must be less than ₹15 Lakhs per year. Priority is given to students below ₹2.5 Lakhs.

eligibility_criteria.text: Must complete mandatory online aptitude assessment (60 mins).
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: You will need to take a simple online multiple-choice quiz covering basic logic and verbal skills.

required_documents.name: Class 12 / UG Marksheet
required_documents.tips: DigiLocker verified marksheets are accepted if physical certificate is delayed.

required_documents.name: College Admission Proof / Fee Receipt
required_documents.format: Fee receipt or student ID or bonafide certificate
required_documents.tips: Must clearly show your student name, roll number, and 1st year admission confirmation.

required_documents.name: Family Income Certificate / ITR
required_documents.format: Valid certificate issued within last 12 months
required_documents.tips: If your parents do not have ITR, get an official income certificate from your local e-District / Tahsildar / Revenue / MeeSeva office.

required_documents.name: Passport Size Photograph & Signature
required_documents.tips: Take a photo against a plain white wall and crop neatly.

faqs.q: Can B.Com, BA, or non-technical students apply?
faqs.a: Yes! Reliance Foundation UG Scholarship welcomes students from all streams including Arts, Commerce, Humanities, Science, Law, and Engineering.
No, this specific scheme is only open to students currently in their 1st year of undergrad or postgrad studies.

title: NITI Aayog Official Government Internship Scheme
provider: NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India, Govt of India)
award_summary: Prestigious Union Govt Experience Certificate + Policy Exposure across 25+ Verticals
deadline_display: Window opens 1st to 10th of every month
summary: Flagship government internship open to students and researchers of ALL disciplines (Law, Economics, Sociology, Commerce, Public Policy, Management, Tech) to work directly on national development policies.

eligibility_criteria.text: Undergraduate students having completed 2nd year with minimum 70% marks, OR Post-graduate / Research scholars with 60% marks.
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: You should have completed at least 2 years of your degree (BA, B.Com, B.Sc, B.Tech, LLB, etc.) with 70%+ marks, or be enrolled in PG.

eligibility_criteria.text: Open to all disciplines: Economics, Law, Commerce, Social Sciences, Management, Science, and Technology.
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: Students from non-technical and technical backgrounds alike are strongly encouraged.

eligibility_criteria.text: Must commit to internship duration of minimum 6 weeks up to 6 months.
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: You must be available to work with NITI Aayog vertical teams for at least 6 weeks.

required_documents.name: NOC / Recommendation Letter from Head of Department or Principal
required_documents.format: Prescribed NITI Aayog format on official letterhead
required_documents.tips: Download the standard NOC format from NITI Aayog website and get it stamped in advance.

required_documents.name: Consolidated Academic Marksheets
required_documents.tips: Ensure marks or CGPA conversion formula is clearly visible.

required_documents.name: Domain Area of Interest Statement (150 words)
required_documents.tips: Pick your vertical (e.g. Agriculture, Education, Health, Public-Private Partnership, or Governance).

faqs.q: Can Arts, Commerce, or Law students apply for NITI Aayog?
faqs.a: Yes! In fact, the majority of NITI Aayog verticals (Education, Health, Governance, Law & Justice, Agriculture) specifically look for Arts, Law, Commerce, and Economics students.

title: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Summer Internship Programme
award_summary: ₹20,000/month stipend + RBI Central Banking Project Experience
summary: Premier paid central banking internship designed for students of Economics, Commerce, Finance, Management, Law, and allied disciplines to research macroeconomic trends.

eligibility_criteria.text: Post-graduate students in Economics, Finance, Commerce, Management, Law, or 5-year integrated law / master's degree.
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: You must be studying Economics, Banking, Commerce, Management, Law, or related PG courses.

eligibility_criteria.text: Final year or pre-final year students with high academic standing.
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: You must be currently enrolled in your pre-final or final year of postgraduate study.

required_documents.name: College Recommendation & Bonafide Letter
required_documents.tips: Request your HOD 1 week before the deadline.

required_documents.name: Statement of Interest in Banking / Monetary Policy
required_documents.tips: Highlight banking reforms, financial inclusion, or digital payments trends in India.

faqs.a: No. Students from Commerce (M.Com), Law (LLM/integrated law), Business Administration (MBA), and Data/Statistics are equally eligible.

title: Teach For India (TFI) 2-Year Leadership Fellowship
funding_type: Paid Salary (₹23,040/month + Housing Allowance & Health Cover)
award_summary: ₹23,040/mo salary + HRA up to ₹10,000/mo + Post-fellowship career recruitment with top firms
summary: Transformative 2-year full-time leadership programme for graduates and working professionals from ALL academic disciplines to teach in high-need classrooms and drive educational equity.

eligibility_criteria.text: Completed Bachelor's degree in any discipline (BA, B.Com, B.Sc, B.Tech, etc.) or graduating by June 2027.
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: You must hold a college degree in any subject or be in your final year of graduation.

eligibility_criteria.text: Indian citizen or Overseas Citizen of India (OCI).
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: Open to Indian citizens passionate about national social impact.

eligibility_criteria.text: Strong English communication and willingness to commit to a 2-year full-time placement.
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: Full-time 2-year paid commitment with living allowance and teacher training.

required_documents.name: Updated Resume / CV
required_documents.tips: Emphasize volunteer work, college leadership roles, or work experience.

required_documents.name: Degree Certificate / Final Year Bonafide
required_documents.tips: Provisional certificate or pre-final marksheet is acceptable for final year applicants.

faqs.q: Can working professionals and career changers apply?
faqs.a: Yes! Approximately 30-40% of TFI Fellows are working professionals transitioning into public policy, consulting, non-profit leadership, or CSR.

title: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS) & NIDHI-EIR
provider: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Govt of India
award_summary: Up to ₹20 Lakhs grant for proof-of-concept + Up to ₹50 Lakhs debt/convertible debenture
summary: Flagship government financial support empowering early-stage founders and aspiring entrepreneurs (college innovators, grads, professionals) to validate prototypes and launch viable startups.

eligibility_criteria.text: DPIIT-recognized startup incorporated not more than 2 years ago, OR an applicant team with an innovative product/service concept.
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: You have an innovative business concept or early prototype addressing a commercial or social challenge.

eligibility_criteria.text: Open to founders across sectors: Agri-tech, Education, Retail, Health, Clean energy, Handicrafts, Waste management, AI/Software.
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: You do NOT need a pure tech startup; traditional innovation, agro-business, creative arts, and services qualify.

eligibility_criteria.text: Indian founders holding minimum 51% shareholding at the time of application.
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: Majority Indian ownership in the founding team.

required_documents.name: Pitch Deck & Problem-Solution Note (PDF max 10 slides)
required_documents.tips: Clearly show target market size, unit economics, prototype status, and planned fund usage.

required_documents.name: DPIIT Certificate or Incorporation Proof (if registered)
required_documents.issuer: Ministry of Corporate Affairs / Startup India
required_documents.tips: DPIIT recognition is 100% free and takes 48 hours on startupindia.gov.in.

faqs.q: Can non-technical students or traditional businesses apply?
faqs.a: Yes! The seed fund actively supports waste management, textile & handicrafts, food processing, logistics, and social ventures, not just software apps.

title: HDFC Bank Parivartan's ECSS Programme for School, College & Professional Studies
award_summary: Up to ₹75,000 financial assistance for tuition, books, and living expenses
summary: Large-scale private CSR scholarship helping meritorious students from economically challenged backgrounds pursuing general graduation (B.Com, BA, B.Sc), professional courses, or polytechnic diplomas.

eligibility_criteria.text: Currently pursuing School (Class 1 to 12), Diploma, General UG/PG (B.Com, B.Sc, BA, BCA, MA, M.Com) or Professional courses.
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: Open to all regular college courses including Arts, Commerce, Science, and Diploma.

eligibility_criteria.text: Must have scored at least 55% marks in the previous qualifying examination.
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: You need minimum 55% aggregate in your previous year.

eligibility_criteria.text: Annual family income must be less than or equal to ₹2,50,000.
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: Priority is strictly given to families facing financial crisis or low income.

required_documents.name: Previous Year Marksheet
required_documents.tips: Marksheet must clearly state total marks and result status.

required_documents.name: Current Year Admission / Fee Receipt
required_documents.format: Official fee receipt showing student name and roll number
required_documents.tips: Bonafide student certificate is also accepted.

required_documents.name: Income Certificate / BPL Card / Ration Card
required_documents.tips: Ensure valid date within past 12 months.

faqs.q: Can B.Com and BA students apply?
faqs.a: Yes! HDFC ECSS has a dedicated track specifically reserved for General Graduation (B.Com, BA, B.Sc).

title: SWAYAM & NPTEL Free National Certifications (Arts, Commerce, Science, Tech)

eligibility_criteria.text: Open to anyone in India: students of all streams, teachers, working professionals, and lifelong learners.
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: Anyone can register for free regardless of educational background or age.

eligibility_criteria.text: 100% free learning materials and video lectures.
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: You can watch all lectures, download readings, and submit weekly quizzes at zero cost.

required_documents.name: Valid Email ID & Mobile Number

faqs.q: Are courses available in non-technical subjects like History, Commerce, and Law?
faqs.a: Yes! SWAYAM offers hundreds of courses in Financial Accounting, Constitutional Law, Indian History, Psychology, Sociology, and Literature.

title: Deloitte Graduate Trainee & Strategy Internship (Commerce, Arts & Tech)
summary: Prestigious corporate internship and early-career track welcoming B.Com, BBA, BA Economics, and STEM graduates to work on consulting, financial advisory, and risk analysis.

eligibility_criteria.text: Pre-final or final year students in B.Com, BBA, BA (Economics/Stats), B.Sc, BCA, or B.Tech.
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: Open to Commerce, Business, Economics, and Tech students graduating in 2026 or 2027.

eligibility_criteria.text: Minimum 60% or 6.0 CGPA throughout academic career with no active backlogs.
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: Consistent academic performance without pending backlogs.

required_documents.name: One-Page Professional Resume
required_documents.tips: Quantify your achievements (e.g. 'Organized fest with 400 attendees', 'Prepared financial ledger').

required_documents.name: Semester Grade Sheets
required_documents.tips: Ensure all semesters are included.

faqs.q: Can B.Com and BBA students apply for Deloitte?
faqs.a: Yes! Deloitte hires thousands of Commerce, Economics, and BBA graduates annually for Audit, Tax, and Financial Advisory roles.

title: Google Summer of Code (GSoC) 2026 Mentorship
summary: 12-week global remote program where students, career changers, and developers contribute to open source organizations under expert 1-on-1 mentorship.

eligibility_criteria.text: At least 18 years of age at the time of registration.
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: You must be 18 years old or older.

eligibility_criteria.text: Currently enrolled in higher education or a verified tech beginner / career changer.
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: Open to college students in any degree and people transitioning into software/open source.

eligibility_criteria.text: Submit a detailed project proposal to an accepted open source organization.
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: You select an open source project (e.g. Python, Blender, Mozilla, Wikipedia) and submit your plan of work.

required_documents.name: Detailed Project Proposal (PDF)
required_documents.format: 5–10 page PDF covering milestones and timeline
required_documents.tips: Discuss with mentors on IRC/Discord before submitting your final PDF.

required_documents.name: Proof of Student Enrollment or Contributor Eligibility
required_documents.tips: College Bonafide certificate or fee receipt works perfectly.

faqs.q: Do I need to be a Computer Science major?
faqs.a: No! Students from any branch (Mechanical, Civil, Arts, Science) can apply if they know programming.

title: Smart India Hackathon (SIH) 2026 — Student Hardware & Software Edition
funding_type: Paid Cash Prize (₹1,00,000 per problem statement)
award_summary: ₹1,00,000 per winning problem statement + National recognition & incubation
verified_source: Ministry of Education Innovation Cell Portal
summary: Nationwide digital initiative where student teams solve pressing real-world challenges posed by Central Ministries, State Governments, and Industries.

eligibility_criteria.text: Team must consist of exactly 6 student members from the same college.
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: Form a 6-member team. All members must study in the same college/institute.

eligibility_criteria.text: At least 1 female team member is strictly mandatory.
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: Your team must include at least one female teammate to qualify.

eligibility_criteria.text: Team nomination must be authorized by College Single Point of Contact (SPOC).
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: Your college principal or assigned hackathon faculty in-charge must approve your entry.

required_documents.name: Idea Presentation Deck (PPT format max 5 slides)

required_documents.name: College SPOC Authorization Letter
required_documents.issuer: College Principal / Dean / Head of Institute
required_documents.tips: Download sample letter template from SIH portal and submit to college office 2 days prior.

faqs.q: Can teammates be from different departments?

eligibility_criteria.text: Project addresses an SDG (e.g. Climate, Clean Water, Quality Education, Poverty Reduction, Gender Equality).
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: Your idea must solve a real community or environmental problem.

faqs.q: Can solo students or non-tech ideas apply?

title: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
provider: Ministry of Education, Govt of India
award_summary: ₹12,000 per annum (Direct Bank Transfer via PFMS)
summary: Central Sector scholarship scheme aimed at curbing dropouts from economically weaker sections by providing recurring cash grants directly to student bank accounts.

eligibility_criteria.text: Parental income from all sources not exceeding ₹3,50,000 per annum.

eligibility_criteria.text: Enrolled in a recognized government, local body, or government-aided institution.

title: ISRO / IIRS Outreach Certification in Remote Sensing & GIS
award_summary: Free Official ISRO Certificate with Grade Sheet + Live Lectures
summary: Premier free government distance learning program by ISRO scientists covering satellite data analysis, environmental mapping, and earth observation technologies.

eligibility_criteria.text: Undergraduate, postgraduate students, or researchers/professionals in any recognized institution.
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: Any student or professional interested in satellite mapping or earth sciences.

eligibility_criteria.text: Must maintain minimum 70% live attendance or session views.
eligibility_criteria.simple_en: Watch online lecture streams on YouTube or IIRS e-class portal to qualify for certificate.

required_documents.name: Student / Professional ID Card Scan

faqs.q: Can Geography, Environmental Science, or BA students apply?
